sn24.8:1.2: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya kim abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || ||
sn24.8:1.3: Sattime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kuṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā
sn24.8:1.4: te na iñjanti na vipariṇāmenti na aññamaññam vyābādhenti || nālam aññamaññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā || || 3
sn24.8:1.6: Pathavīkāyo apokāyo tejokāyo vāyokāyo || sukhe dukkhe jīve || || Sattime
sn24.8:1.7: kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kuṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā
sn24.8:1.8: te na iñjanti na vipariṇāmenti na aññamaññaṃ vyābādhenti || nālam aññamaññāssa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā || || 4
sn24.8:1.9: Yo pi tiṇhena satthena sīsaṃ chindati na koci taṃ jīvitā voropeti ||
sn24.8:1.10: sattannaṃ tveva kāyānam antarena sattham vivaram anupavisati || || 5
sn24.8:1.11: Cuddasa kho panimāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni || pañca kammasatāni pañca ca kammāni tīni ca kammāni kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā dvaṭṭhantarakappā chaḷābhijātiyo aṭṭhapurisabhūmiyo ekūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate ekūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate ekūnapaññāsanāgavāsasate vīse indriyasate tiṃse niriyasate chattiṃsa rajodhātuyo satta saññīgabbhā satta asaññīgabbhā satta nigaṇṭhigabbhā satta dibbā satta mānusā satta pesācā satta sarā satta pavudhā satta papātā satta ca papātasatāni satta supinā satta ca supinasatāni cullāsīti mahākappuno satasahassāni bāle ca paṇḍite ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti || || 6
sn24.8:1.12: Tattha natthi Imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā aparipakkaṃ vā kammam paripācessami
sn24.8:1.13: paripakkaṃ vā kammam phussa phussa vyantikarissamīti hevam natthi || doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre natthi hāyanavaḍḍhane natthi ukkhaṃsāvakaṃse || || 7
sn24.8:1.14: Seyyathāpi nāma suttaguḷe khitte nibbeṭhiyamānam eva paleti
sn24.8:1.15: evam evam bāle ca paṇḍite ca nibbeṭhiyamānā sukhadukkham palentīti || || 8
sn24.8:2.1: Rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati
sn24.8:2.7: Viññāṇe sati viññāṇam upādāya viññāṇam abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati || ||
sn24.8:3.2: Rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn24.8:3.4: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.8:3.5: Sattime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā || pa || sukhaṃ
sn24.8:3.8: Yam pi diṭṭhaṃ sutam mutaṃ viññātam pattam pariyesitam anuvicaritam manasā tam pi niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn24.8:3.10: Api nu tam anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya
sn24.8:4.1: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imesu chasu ṭhānesu kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti || dukkhapissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti || la || dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya pissa kaṅkhā pahīnā hoti ||
sn24.8:4.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako sotāpanno avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 1-2
